tools.name: ghidra_help
tools.description: Get the domain tools, the operations of one domain, or the parameter schema, the md5 rule and the effects of one operation. Before the first call to an operation, set domain to its tool name and operation to its name. The returned inputSchema describes params, not the top-level tool arguments. Pass no arguments to list the domain tools.

domain.description: A domain tool name, such as ghidra_function, or a domain name

operation.description: An operation of the domain. Requires domain.

tools.name: ghidra_session
tools.description: Use this tool to open, list, examine, and close the binary sessions of the daemon. Select an operation: open, list, get, close. Before your first call to an operation, call ghidra_help with domain="ghidra_session" and the operation name. Read its inputSchema for the required fields, types, and nested objects in params. Do not guess fields. Set md5 when the operation names a session. ghidra_help shows the md5 rule of each operation.

md5.description: The binary MD5: exactly 32 hexadecimal characters. Use the actual file digest or the MD5 of an existing session, not a name or label.

params.description: The parameters for the selected operation. If you do not have its schema, call ghidra_help with the domain and operation before you set parameters.
